how: Second Google Maps pass (2026-11-24) over all 4,747 sights and 909 care rows; rows flagged Permanently/Temporarily closed that round 1 had not already decided were re-opened on Maps and checked on the web. 1,694 sights and 643 care lookups loaded no Maps result and are not covered by this pass.

rows.name: Cappadocia Art & History Museum (dolls)
rows.evidence: Maps (re-run with the Turkish name 'Kapadokya Sanat ve Tarih Müzesi/Kitre Bebek Müzesi', Mustafapaşa) shows this very place 'Temporarily closed'; a web search found no reopening date and no 2026 page saying it is open. The town keeps 18 sights, 7 indoors.

rows.name: Eisriesenwelt Ice Cave
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' in November; the row's tip already says open 1 May – end of October (the cave's own 2026 info PDF).

rows.name: Altaussee Salt Mine (Salzwelten)
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' in November; the row's tip already gives the season (to 2 November) and says it may be shut in winter.

rows.name: Centreville Amusement Park
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' again; decided in round 1 (summer season only, already in the row).
